about: A slow, heavy giant's walk keyed from measured targets (tools/characters/keyed_walk.py): research/2026-10-26-giant-walker-weight.md scales a person's heavy 0.8 s step by the root of a 2.9 m leg to 1.45 s; the weight sits in the down pose just after each contact, the crown nods after it. Metres on the body it is keyed for, degrees, seconds.
name: Giant_Walk
